summary: ALX Oncology filed an 8-K disclosing privately negotiated exchange agreements dated October 14, 2026 with existing holders, under which 13,353,384 common shares were surrendered in return for pre-funded warrants on the same share count, settling about October 15, 2026. Participants included Blackstone Annex Master Fund (12,885,891 shares), RA Capital (213,667), and venBio Global Strategic Fund (253,826). Warrants carry a $0.001 exercise price, cashless exercise, and 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership blockers, increasable up to 19.99% only after 61 days' notice. Issued under Section 3(a)(9) exemption; the exchange is a balance-sheet/structural recapitalization maneuver that preserves economic exposure while recasting the register; watch for exercise-driven share overhang, registration rights, and future monetization or strategic alternatives.
